_note: Staging catalogue for push-notification honesty (lib/push/*, app/(auth)/permissions.tsx, lib/api/settingsQueries.ts). lib/i18n/index.ts loads only locales/{en,fr}.json, so lib/push/strings.ts registers this bundle at runtime via i18n.addResourceBundle — see that file before merging. TWO kinds of entry live here. (1) `push.*` are NEW keys: fold them into locales/{en,fr}.json under a top-level `push` object and they keep working unchanged. (2) `corrections.*` REPLACE keys that already exist in locales/{en,fr}.json and are rendered by app/settings.tsx, which this change does not own. `corrections.always` adds settings.device.unavailable, the copy for the new PushRegistrationError member 'unavailable' (app/settings.tsx renders t(`settings.device.${push.error}`), so the key name is load-bearing — do not rename it). `corrections.whenUndeliverable` is applied ONLY while this build genuinely cannot receive a push (no EAS projectId, or web); the moment the owner supplies EAS credentials the original locales/{en,fr}.json wording is used again untouched, so this override retires itself. Key set MUST stay 1:1 with push.fr.json.

permissions.title: Notifications
permissions.bodyDeliverable: Appointment reminders, new results and consent requests, sent to this phone.
permissions.bodyUnavailable: Reminders, results and consent requests appear in the app's notification centre.
permissions.noteUnavailable: This app build cannot deliver alerts to your phone's lock screen yet, so OpesCare does not ask for the notification permission. Nothing is missed — open Notifications inside the app to see everything OpesCare has sent you.

device.unavailable: This app build cannot deliver alerts to your phone yet, so this switch cannot be turned on. Everything OpesCare sends still appears in the in-app notification centre.

device.pushBody: Not available in this build. Alerts appear in the notification centre instead.
